Siberian tigers r my favorite tiger sub species but I rlly don’t like this edit😓😓😢 in my defense I stayed up late doing this sk if it comes out trash im soso sorry AND ITS FREAKING OFF SYNC UGH OMFG IHML I HATW THJS EDIT ♯ The Siberian tiger, also known as the Amur tiger (Panthera tigris altaica), is recognized as the world's largest wild cat subspecies. Native primarily to the snowy boreal forests of the Russian Far East and parts of northeastern China, adult males can grow up to 10–12 feet in length and weigh over 600 pounds, while females are noticeably smaller. They are uniquely adapted to extreme cold, featuring a dense, pale orange coat with fewer and wider stripes, a thick layer of belly fat, and shaggy winter fur. As solitary apex predators, their diet consists mainly of wild boar, elk, and deer, and they can consume up to 60 pounds of meat in a single meal. KIMBA & AFRICA ENJOY A SCRATCH. Seven tigers removed from tiny cages in Circo Rey Gitano in Guatemala are in an ADI Temporary Rescue Unit (ADI TRU) while preparations are made to take them to a new life at the ADI Wildlife Sanctuary. This is a temporary hospital facility where the cages used to remove the tigers from the circus are joined together to give the animals more space.  Already the tigers have more space than they had in the circus and in some cases, more than three times the space. The animals can be separated for feeding, veterinary treatment and for cage cleaning – a cage is being cleaned in the background. We will soon be adding exercise enclosures with small pools.  The ADI Wildlife Sanctuary in South Africa will be their forever home with huge natural enclosures  – each tiger will have at least 10,000 square meters / 107,639 square feet. All seven tigers were successfully removed from the circus by Guatemala’s animal welfare division, Unidad de Bienestar Animal (UBA) and wildlife department Consejo Nacional de Areas Protegidas (CONAP) and police.  All are well at the ADI TRU and this has been verified by officials and the Guatemala media. These tigers deserve some freedom for their final years, don’t let them be forced back into the tiny circus cages they have endured for years. Speak up for the tigers. #StopCircusSuffering
